shortcut_probes.cue: Reciprocal-and-square exponential signature in answer bank
shortcut_probes.strategy: Ignore prompt and solution. Among exponential factors, select the one having both its reciprocal and its square present in the answer bank. Equivalent visible strategy: of the two same-sign exponential exponents, select the smaller absolute coefficient.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 100% success without seeing the ODE or solution; baseline 1/5 uniform guessing. Exponent comparison alone identifies the answer-producing action.
